objets.intro: Create, edit and delete this server's shop items.
objets.injoignable: The catalogue could not be read (bot API unreachable). Try again later.
objets.aucun: No item yet. Click “New item” to create one.

editeur.achetableAide: Available in the shop, at the price above.
editeur.echangeableAide: Members can give it to each other.
editeur.dropAide: Can be found in mini-games / the Endless Road.
editeur.effetsAide: What the item does when a member runs /utiliser.
editeur.effetsIndisponibles: Effect list unavailable (bot API unreachable, or a version older than the effect editor). Effects already saved are kept as they are.
editeur.cooldown: Cooldown between two uses (seconds) — e.g. 3600 = 1 hour, 0 = none

effets.aucun: No effect. Add one to define what the item does when used.
effets.inconnuAide: Effect unknown to this dashboard (newer bot). It is kept as it is; pick another type to replace it.

plafond.aide: Global setting (bot owner). 0 or empty = unlimited. Currently: {valeur}.
